gloss: another day; some other time; in the future

definitions.gloss: another day; some other time; in the future
definitions.explanation: Refers to an unspecified day in the future. A formal, literary expression used in writing and polite speech.

examples.japanese: {他日|たじつ}お⟦{会|あ}い→会う：00482_au⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
{他日|たじつ}、{改|あらた}めてご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will contact you again on another occasion.

examples.japanese: {他日|たじつ}、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Someday in the future, the day will come when this experience proves useful.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal and somewhat literary word. In everyday speech, ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (another day) or ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧ (some other time) are more commonly used. {他日|たじつ} appears in formal correspondence and literary writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他日|たじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{期|き}す (to look forward to another occasion)
- {他日|たじつ}{改|あらた}めて (on another day, anew)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧: at a later date — focuses on a specific future date
- いつか: someday — casual, everyday equivalent
